                    阅读7分钟
                  </span> <!----></div></div> <div style="flex:1;" data-v-61fb5e44=""></div> <!----> <!----></div> <!----> <!----> <!----> <!----> <div id="article-root" itemprop="articleBody" class="main" data-v-61fb5e44=""><div class="article-viewer markdown-body cache result"><p>最近接了个可视化 demo 的活，要在地图上展示火源点和周边资源（取水点、消防站、监测云台、机场）的关联关系。产品给的参考图是那种大屏风格——卫星底图、彩色弧线连到火点、线上有光点流动、弧线还会呼吸闪烁。</p>
<p>一开始想的是 ECharts GL 或者 Mapbox，但客户明确要 3D 地球视角，能转、能俯冲那种。最后选了 <strong>Cesium</strong>，一个 HTML 文件就能跑，方便给甲方预览。</p>
<p>本文记录整个 demo 的实现思路，以及我踩过的两个坑：<strong>弧线拱太高</strong>、<strong>初始相机把北侧标注裁出屏幕</strong>。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">最终效果长什么样</h2>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/32da1141e33a47c283668bf1b2946a91~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5bCY5LiW5Lit5LiA5L2N6L-36YCU5bCP5Lmm56ul:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790311325&amp;x-signature=xjqTRhrrPo3Vxc6k6Ma9BD1Cxwg%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://p9-xtjj-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-73owjymdk6/ed8207f0836c442b95151da56d5eadb9~tplv-73owjymdk6-jj-mark-v1:0:0:0:0:5o6Y6YeR5oqA5pyv56S-5Yy6IEAg5bCY5LiW5Lit5LiA5L2N6L-36YCU5bCP5Lmm56ul:q75.awebp?rk3s=f64ab15b&amp;x-expires=1790311325&amp;x-signature=4bP%2F60KWRSSDRYqwesdEjHLWO6c%3D" alt="image.png" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>核心视觉就四块：</p>
<ol>
<li>火源点 + 半透明扩散椭圆</li>
<li>各资源站点图标 + 文字标注</li>
<li>站点到火点的<strong>抛物线弧线</strong>（底色 + 发光层）</li>
<li>弧线上** Canvas 2D 粒子**流动</li>
</ol>
<p>UI 层是普通的 HTML/CSS 叠在 Cesium 上面，右侧态势面板数据是 mock 的，隔几秒随机跳一下，营造"实时"的感觉。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">项目结构：就一个 HTML</h2>
<p>没有 Webpack，没有 Vue，CDN 引入 Cesium 1.114，<code>&lt;script&gt;</code> 里写完逻辑，浏览器直接打开。</p>
<p>这样做的好处是：<strong>改完刷新就能看</strong>，跟甲方对需求的时候特别省事。后面如果要进 Vue/React 项目，把 <code>&lt;script&gt;</code> 里的逻辑拆到组件里就行，Cesium API 本身不变。</p>
<p>唯一前置条件：去 <a href="https://link.juejin.cn?target=https%3A%2F%2Fcesium.com%2Fion%2Fsignup" target="_blank" title="https://cesium.com/ion/signup" ref="nofollow noopener noreferrer">Cesium Ion</a> 注册拿 Token，替换代码里的 <code>CESIUM_ION_TOKEN</code>。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">第一步：先把 Viewer 搭起来</h2>
<p>Cesium 默认 UI 一大堆，大屏用不上，全关掉：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">viewer = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Viewer</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'cesiumContainer'</span>, {
  <span class="hljs-attr">baseLayer</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ImageryLayer</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromProviderAsync</span>(
    <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">IonImageryProvider</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromAssetId</span>(<span class="hljs-number">3</span>), <span class="hljs-comment">// 卫星影像</span>
  ),
  <span class="hljs-attr">terrainProvider</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">EllipsoidTerrainProvider</span>(),
  <span class="hljs-attr">animation</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">timeline</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">baseLayerPicker</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">geocoder</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">homeButton</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">sceneModePicker</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">navigationHelpButton</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">fullscreenButton</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">infoBox</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">selectionIndicator</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">requestRenderMode</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 有动画，不能开按需渲染</span>
})
</code></pre>
<p>另外关了几个吃性能但大屏不需要的效果：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">scene.<span class="hljs-property">globe</span>.<span class="hljs-property">showGroundAtmosphere</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
scene.<span class="hljs-property">skyAtmosphere</span>.<span class="hljs-property">show</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
scene.<span class="hljs-property">fog</span>.<span class="hljs-property">enabled</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
scene.<span class="hljs-property">globe</span>.<span class="hljs-property">enableLighting</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
scene.<span class="hljs-property">globe</span>.<span class="hljs-property">depthTestAgainstTerrain</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 标注不要被地形挡住</span>
scene.<span class="hljs-property">backgroundColor</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Color</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromCssColorString</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'#0a0d12'</span>)
</code></pre>
<p><code>depthTestAgainstTerrain = false</code> 这个我一开始没关，结果山多的地方 label 时隐时现，排查了半天。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">弧线怎么做：别用大地线，自己插值</h2>
<p>Cesium 画线默认会走 <code>ArcType.GEODESIC</code>（贴地球表面的大圆弧）。我们要的是<strong>拱起来的抛物线</strong>，所以必须设 <code>arcType: Cesium.ArcType.NONE</code>，然后自己算每个点的经纬度和高度。</p>
<p>核心就一行：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> h = arcHeight * <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PI</span> * t) <span class="hljs-comment">// t 从 0 到 1，两端高度为 0，中间最高</span>
</code></pre>
<p>完整函数：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">makeArcPositions</span>(<span class="hljs-params">lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2, arcHeight, nPoints = <span class="hljs-number">48</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> out = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Array</span>(nPoints + <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">for</span> (<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> i = <span class="hljs-number">0</span>; i &lt;= nPoints; i++) {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> t = i / nPoints
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> lon = lon1 + (lon2 - lon1) * t
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> lat = lat1 + (lat2 - lat1) * t
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> h = arcHeight * <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PI</span> * t)
    out[i] = <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromDegrees</span>(lon, lat, h)
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> out
}
</code></pre>
<p>48 个点够平滑了，加到 100 肉眼几乎看不出区别，还浪费顶点。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-4">坑 1：弧高别写死，不然能拱到天上</h3>
<p>我第一版给每条线写死了 <code>arcH: 58000</code> 这种值（单位米）。水平距离才五六公里，弧顶五六十公里——打开页面弧线直接戳出屏幕，跟发射导弹似的。</p>
<p>后来改成<strong>按两点距离动态算</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">calcArcHeight</span>(<span class="hljs-params">lon1, lat1, lon2, lat2</span>) {
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromDegrees</span>(lon1, lat1, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>, _arcScratchA)
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromDegrees</span>(lon2, lat2, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-literal">undefined</span>, _arcScratchB)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> dist = <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">distance</span>(_arcScratchA, _arcScratchB)
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(dist * <span class="hljs-number">0.12</span>, <span class="hljs-number">4500</span>) <span class="hljs-comment">// 距离的 12%，上限 4.5km</span>
}
</code></pre>
<p><code>0.12</code> 和 <code>4500</code> 是我调了几版之后的值，不同场景可以微调。原则就一条：<strong>弧高跟水平距离成比例</strong>，别搞成固定大数。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-5">弧线分两层：底色 + 发光</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-6">底色层：4 条线合并成 1 次 draw call</h3>
<p>用 <code>Primitive</code> + <code>GeometryInstance</code> 批量提交，比每条线单独 <code>entities.add</code> 省：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> instances = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">STATIONS</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">st</span> =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">GeometryInstance</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">geometry</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">PolylineGeometry</span>({
    <span class="hljs-attr">positions</span>: <span class="hljs-title function_">makeArcPositions</span>(st.<span class="hljs-property">lon</span>, st.<span class="hljs-property">lat</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">FIRE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lon</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">FIRE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lat</span>, st.<span class="hljs-property">arcH</span>),
    <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1.5</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">arcType</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ArcType</span>.<span class="hljs-property">NONE</span>,
  }),
  <span class="hljs-attr">attributes</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">ColorGeometryInstanceAttribute</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromColor</span>(
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Color</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromCssColorString</span>(st.<span class="hljs-property">color</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">withAlpha</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0.25</span>),
    ),
  },
}))

scene.<span class="hljs-property">primitives</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">add</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">Primitive</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">geometryInstances</span>: instances,
  <span class="hljs-attr">appearance</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">PolylineColorAppearance</span>({ <span class="hljs-attr">translucent</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> }),
  <span class="hljs-attr">releaseGeometryInstances</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">allowPicking</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>,
}))
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-7">发光层：PolylineGlow + 正弦呼吸</h3>
<p>上层用 <code>Entity</code> + <code>PolylineGlowMaterialProperty</code>，颜色 alpha 用 <code>CallbackProperty</code> 驱动正弦波，每条线相位错开 <code>idx * (Math.PI * 0.5)</code>，避免齐刷刷闪。</p>
<p>一个小优化：<code>CallbackProperty</code> 里用 <code>performance.now()</code> 算时间，别用 <code>JulianDate</code> 做差值——后者每帧会 new 对象，动画开久了 GC 压力明显。</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">CallbackProperty</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> t = performance.<span class="hljs-title function_">now</span>() / <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> alpha = <span class="hljs-number">0.25</span> + <span class="hljs-number">0.65</span> * (<span class="hljs-number">0.5</span> + <span class="hljs-number">0.5</span> * <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(t * <span class="hljs-number">1.6</span> + phase))
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">abs</span>(alpha - _lastAlpha) &gt; <span class="hljs-number">0.005</span>) {
    _cachedColor = baseColor.<span class="hljs-title function_">withAlpha</span>(alpha)
    _lastAlpha = alpha
  }
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> _cachedColor
}, <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>),
</code></pre>
<p>alpha 变化小于 0.005 就不重新 <code>clone</code>，也是抠细节。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-8">粒子动画：别走 Cesium，自己画 Canvas</h2>
<p>弧线上的流动光点，如果用 Cesium 的 <code>PointPrimitive</code> 或 <code>Entity</code> 做 80 个动画点，每帧改 position，开销不小。</p>
<p>我的做法是：<strong>单独盖一层 2D Canvas</strong>，用 <code>scene.cartesianToCanvasCoordinates</code> 把弧线上的世界坐标投影到屏幕，然后在 Canvas 上画圆点。</p>
<p>流程：</p>
<ol>
<li>启动时预计算所有弧线的 48 个世界坐标点（静态，不变）</li>
<li>维护 80 个粒子的对象池，每个粒子有 <code>t</code>（0~1 进度）和 <code>speed</code></li>
<li>每帧 <code>t += speed</code>，用 <code>floor(t * 48)</code> 取当前点，投影到屏幕，画带 shadow 的圆</li>
<li><code>t &gt;= 1</code> 重置，循环播放</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> idx = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">min</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">floor</span>(p.<span class="hljs-property">t</span> * <span class="hljs-variable constant_">N_POINTS</span>), <span class="hljs-variable constant_">N_POINTS</span> - <span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> worldPt = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">ARC_POINTS</span>[p.<span class="hljs-property">si</span>][idx]
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> screen = scene.<span class="hljs-title function_">cartesianToCanvasCoordinates</span>(worldPt, _scratchScreen)
<span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (!screen) <span class="hljs-keyword">continue</span>

pCtx.<span class="hljs-property">globalAlpha</span> = <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">sin</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PI</span> * p.<span class="hljs-property">t</span>) * <span class="hljs-number">0.85</span>
pCtx.<span class="hljs-property">shadowColor</span> = p.<span class="hljs-property">color</span>
pCtx.<span class="hljs-property">shadowBlur</span> = <span class="hljs-number">7</span>
pCtx.<span class="hljs-property">fillStyle</span> = p.<span class="hljs-property">color</span>
pCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">beginPath</span>()
pCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">arc</span>(screen.<span class="hljs-property">x</span>, screen.<span class="hljs-property">y</span>, p.<span class="hljs-property">size</span>, <span class="hljs-number">0</span>, <span class="hljs-title class_">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-property">PI</span> * <span class="hljs-number">2</span>)
pCtx.<span class="hljs-title function_">fill</span>()
</code></pre>
<p>粒子完全绕开了 Cesium 渲染管线，相机怎么转都能跟住。<code>_scratchScreen</code> 复用一个 <code>Cartesian2</code>，避免每帧 new。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-9">标注图标：Canvas 画 emoji，不用图片资源</h2>
<p>站点图标没用 PNG，直接用 Canvas 画圆底 + emoji：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">makeIconDataURL</span>(<span class="hljs-params">emoji, bg, size = <span class="hljs-number">52</span></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> key = <span class="hljs-string">`<span class="hljs-subst">${emoji}</span>_<span class="hljs-subst">${bg}</span>_<span class="hljs-subst">${size}</span>`</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (_iconCache[key]) <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> _iconCache[key] <span class="hljs-comment">// 缓存，同类型只画一次</span>
  
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> c = <span class="hljs-variable language_">document</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">createElement</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'canvas'</span>)
  <span class="hljs-comment">// ... 画外圈光晕、实心圆、描边、emoji</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> c.<span class="hljs-title function_">toDataURL</span>()
}
</code></pre>
<p>好处：零 HTTP 请求，改颜色只改参数，Billboard 直接 <code>image: makeIconDataURL('💧', '#00d4ff')</code>。</p>
<p>Billboard 和 Label 绑在同一个 <code>Entity</code> 上，比分开 add 少一半 draw call。<code>disableDepthTestDistance: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY</code> 保证标注永远在最前面。</p>
<p>火场范围用 <code>EllipseGeometry</code> + <code>Primitive</code> 画半透明椭圆，比 Entity 静态图形性能好一点。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-10">坑 2：相机别写死坐标</h2>
<p>第一版相机写死：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript">viewer.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">flyTo</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">destination</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromDegrees</span>(<span class="hljs-number">119.82</span>, <span class="hljs-number">29.13</span>, <span class="hljs-number">52000</span>),
  <span class="hljs-attr">orientation</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">pitch</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toRadians</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">45</span>) },
})
</code></pre>
<p>弧线高度调低之后，北侧的取水点和机场直接出屏幕了——俯角太陡，视心偏南。</p>
<p>改成<strong>根据所有标注点算包围球自动取景</strong>：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">function</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">initCamera</span>(<span class="hljs-params"></span>) {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> positions = <span class="hljs-variable constant_">STATIONS</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">st</span> =&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromDegrees</span>(st.<span class="hljs-property">lon</span>, st.<span class="hljs-property">lat</span>),
  )
  positions.<span class="hljs-title function_">push</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Cartesian3</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromDegrees</span>(<span class="hljs-variable constant_">FIRE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lon</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">FIRE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lat</span>))

  <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> boundingSphere = <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">BoundingSphere</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">fromPoints</span>(positions)
  boundingSphere.<span class="hljs-property">radius</span> *= <span class="hljs-number">1.6</span>

  viewer.<span class="hljs-property">camera</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">flyToBoundingSphere</span>(boundingSphere, {
    <span class="hljs-attr">duration</span>: <span class="hljs-number">2.8</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">offset</span>: <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">HeadingPitchRange</span>(
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toRadians</span>(<span class="hljs-number">10</span>),
      <span class="hljs-title class_">Cesium</span>.<span class="hljs-property">Math</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">toRadians</span>(-<span class="hljs-number">32</span>),
      boundingSphere.<span class="hljs-property">radius</span> * <span class="hljs-number">3.5</span>,
    ),
  })
}
</code></pre>
<p>俯角从 -45° 调到 -32°，视距按包围球半径算。以后加新站点不用改相机参数，自动框进去。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-11">数据层：一个数组驱动全部</h2>
<p>所有站点配置集中在一个 <code>STATIONS</code> 数组，弧线、图标、粒子颜色都从这里读：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-javascript" lang="javascript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-variable constant_">STATIONS</span> = [
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'water'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lon</span>: <span class="hljs-number">119.78</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lat</span>: <span class="hljs-number">29.18</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'XX取水点'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">dist</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'5.9km'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#00d4ff'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">icon</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'💧'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'fire'</span>,  <span class="hljs-attr">lon</span>: <span class="hljs-number">119.76</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lat</span>: <span class="hljs-number">29.13</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'XX消防站'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">dist</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'6.1km'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#00ff88'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">icon</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'🏠'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'monitor'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lon</span>: <span class="hljs-number">119.82</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lat</span>: <span class="hljs-number">29.07</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'XX监测点云台'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">dist</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'3.2km'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#ffcc00'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">icon</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'📷'</span> },
  { <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'airport'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lon</span>: <span class="hljs-number">119.88</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">lat</span>: <span class="hljs-number">29.19</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'XX机场'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">dist</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'2.8km'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">color</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#aa88ff'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">icon</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'✈️'</span> },
]

<span class="hljs-variable constant_">STATIONS</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">forEach</span>(<span class="hljs-function"><span class="hljs-params">st</span> =&gt;</span> {
  st.<span class="hljs-property">arcH</span> = <span class="hljs-title function_">calcArcHeight</span>(st.<span class="hljs-property">lon</span>, st.<span class="hljs-property">lat</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">FIRE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lon</span>, <span class="hljs-variable constant_">FIRE</span>.<span class="hljs-property">lat</span>)
})
</code></pre>
<p>接真实接口的时候，把 <code>STATIONS</code> 换成 API 返回的数据，重新跑一遍 <code>buildStaticArcs / buildGlowArcs / buildLabels / initCamera</code> 就行。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-12">性能小结</h2>

































<table><thead><tr><th>点</th><th>做法</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>静态弧线</td><td>4 条合并 1 个 Primitive</td></tr><tr><td>发光弧线</td><td>Entity + 缓存 alpha，减少 clone</td></tr><tr><td>粒子</td><td>Canvas 2D，对象池，预计算路径</td></tr><tr><td>图标</td><td>Canvas 生成 + 内存缓存</td></tr><tr><td>标注</td><td>Billboard + Label 同 Entity</td></tr><tr><td>相机</td><td>包围球自适应，不写死</td></tr></tbody></table>
<p>这个 demo 标注点个位数，谈不上压力测试。但如果要上百条线，静态层继续合并 Primitive、动画粒子保持 Canvas 方案、Entity 能少则少，方向是对的。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-13">怎么跑</h2>
<ol>
<li>去 Cesium Ion 注册，复制 Access Token</li>
<li>替换代码里的 <code>CESIUM_ION_TOKEN</code></li>
<li>浏览器直接打开 <code>map.html</code>（要联网，Cesium 资源走 CDN）</li>
</ol>
<p>Token 别提交到公开仓库，生产环境走环境变量。</p>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-14">后续可以扩展的方向</h2>
<ul>
<li>弧线改为 WebSocket 推送的实时调度路径</li>
<li>点击站点弹详情面板（Cesium 的 <code>ScreenSpaceEventHandler</code>）</li>
<li>接真实地形 <code>Cesium.createWorldTerrainAsync()</code>，山区效果更立体</li>
<li>迁到 Vue 3：<code>onMounted</code> 里 init Viewer，<code>onUnmounted</code> 里 <code>viewer.destroy()</code></li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 data-id="heading-15">写在最后</h2>
<p>Cesium 做这种"地图 + 关系线 + 动效"的大屏，上手门槛比 ECharts 高，但 3D 视角确实唬人。几个关键点：</p>
<ul>
<li>抛物线弧线自己插值，<code>ArcType.NONE</code></li>
<li>弧高跟距离挂钩，别写死大数字</li>
<li>粒子动画放 Canvas，别硬塞进 Cesium 管线</li>
<li>相机用包围球，别凭感觉写坐标</li>
</ul>
<p>完整代码在一个 HTML 文件里，700 多行，注释写得比较细，需要的话可以直接拿去改。</p>
<p>如果你也在做类似的可视化，欢迎评论区交流踩坑经验。</p>
<hr>
<p><strong>标签：</strong> <code>Cesium</code> <code>可视化</code> <code>JavaScript</code> <code>GIS</code> <code>大屏</code></p></div></div>
